preconditions.description: The input tree has exactly n nodes, where n is an integer between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in edges) and len(edges) == n - 1
preconditions.description: The input consists of n-1 edges, each connecting two distinct nodes in the range [1, n]. The edges form an undirected tree (connected and acyclic).

preconditions.expression: len(set().union(*[(a, b), (b, a) for a, b in edges])) == n - 1
preconditions.description: The edges do not contain duplicate connections (no multi-edges).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= k <= n for k in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in decomposition_nodes])
postconditions.description: Each node in the T-decomposition has a cardinality k (number of original nodes) between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(line.split()[1:])) == k for k, line in zip([int(line.split()[0]) for line in decomposition_nodes], decomposition_nodes))
postconditions.description: Each decomposition node contains exactly k distinct original nodes, as specified by its cardinality.

postconditions.expression: set().union(*[set(line.split()[1:]) for line in decomposition_nodes]) == set(range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The union of all decomposition nodes covers all original nodes exactly once (condition 1 of T-decomposition).

postconditions.expression: all(any(a in line.split()[1:] and b in line.split()[1:] for line in decomposition_nodes) for a, b in edges)
postconditions.description: For every edge (a, b) in the original tree, there exists at least one decomposition node containing both a and b (condition 2 of T-decomposition).

postconditions.expression: all(all(a in line.split()[1:] or a not in set().union(*[set(line.split()[1:]) for line in decomposition_nodes]) for line in decomposition_nodes) for a in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: For every original node a, the decomposition nodes containing a form a connected subtree in the decomposition tree (condition 3 of T-decomposition).

postconditions.expression: max(int(line.split()[0]) for line in decomposition_nodes) == min_weight
postconditions.description: The weight of the T-decomposition (maximum cardinality of any decomposition node) is minimized.
The number of nodes in the T-decomposition is minimized among all optimal T-decompositions.
The decomposition edges form a valid tree structure connecting all decomposition nodes (connected and acyclic).
